blocks.text: TEHRAN, Iran — Iran has unveiled a new missile launcher as senior military commanders touted the Islamic republic’s capabilities in defiant messages to the United States. “A launcher capable of firing two liquid-propellant missiles simultaneously was unveiled for the first time,” Iranian state television reported on Saturday. State television broadcast footage of Revolutionary Guards chief Ahmad Vahidi and the head of the Guards’ aerospace forces, Majid Mousavi, touring an underground missile base.
